newsitem.title: EGYPT: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt Q1 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt Q1 profits up.

text.p: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt increased its net profits in the first quarter of the Islamic year 1417 by 12.33 percent to 82 million pounds from 73 million in the same period a year ago, the bank said on Monday.
The Islamic year started on May 19.
The bank's total assets went up to 6.451 billion pounds in the first quarter, which ended on August 15, 1996, from 6.27 billion at the end of the first quarter of the year 1416.
Client deposits at the bank, which has a paid capital of $100 million, rose to 5.045 billion pounds from 4.913 billion.
The bank, which does not work on interest forbidden in Islam, set up or participated in 38 companies by the end of the first quarter, with aggregate capital of 1.121 billion pounds.
